observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for parents who want practical reassurance before buying. We have no approved reviews or certifications to quote. Use available product information and support without implying the home becomes child-safe.

variants.primary_text: If furniture edges are on your childproofing checklist, start with a specific detail. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge and corner protectors, giving you a way to address table corners and other furniture edges as you plan your home. They’re one part of childproofing—not a substitute for adult supervision. Explore the kit.
variants.headline: Address furniture edges with a child safety kit

variants.primary_text: Childproofing isn’t only about furniture. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit also includes socket guards, so outlets can be part of the childproofing plan you make for your home. Consider which areas you want to address, and remember that adult supervision remains important. See the kit details.
variants.headline: Socket guards for your childproofing plan

variants.primary_text: Want guidance as you work through installation? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you can get help with the process rather than figuring out each step alone. If installation support matters to you, take a look at the kit and what’s included.
variants.headline: Get 1-to-1 installation video support

output.internal_notes: Copy uses the supplied product and offer observations only. No compatibility, installation-time, safety-outcome, testimonial, or certification claims added. Guarantee claims omitted because eligibility details were not supplied. Adult supervision is not presented as optional.
